description: Utilised inbound foreign direct investment into China (吸收外商直接投资) and newly established FDI enterprises — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE figures, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. The monetary amount (USD 100M) stopped being published through this feed around mid-2023 — recent rows carry the enterprise COUNT only, with the dollar figure null. Answers "how much FDI is China attracting", "new foreign-invested enterprises in China this year".

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.
